_comment: Octail's own egg (pelican-eggs' games-steamcmd dayz egg was read as a reference only). App 223350 (DayZ Server) is not available to anonymous SteamCMD logins, so the egg uses Octail's steam_login feature (required): the Steam account picked on the Startup tab logs in, Steam Guard codes are asked for in the console and the login is cached for start-time updates. An account that owns DayZ is recommended: the vanilla missions only update with it, and Steam Workshop downloads (app 221100, the steam.workshop tool) need it. The Linux depot (DayZServer) is downloaded, SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times and the install fails when DayZServer is missing. serverDZ.cfg is written by the install when missing; its name, passwords, slots, view, time, query port and mission lines are set by the file parser before every start (steamQueryPort is appended when the file has none), and a missing mission folder stops the start. Mods as in arma-3.json. The Steam (+2) and BattlEye (+4) ports are reserved with fixed_ports, the query port (+1) and the optional BattlEye RCon port (+3) are variables. The server reads no console input and stops on Ctrl+C. SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: DayZ
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Bohemia Interactive's DayZ: the official Linux dedicated server (DayZServer) from SteamCMD, with Workshop and uploaded mods. Needs a logged-in Steam account; one that owns DayZ is recommended.
startup:
if [ ! -d "mpmissions/${MISSION}" ]; then echo "The mission folder mpmissions/${MISSION} is missing: upload it or pick another mission on the Startup tab."; exit 1; fi; grep -q "^steamQueryPort" serverDZ.cfg || printf "
steamQueryPort = %s;
" "${QUERY_PORT}" >> serverDZ.cfg; octail_mods=""; for octail_id in ${WORKSHOP_MODS//,/ }; do octail_mods="${octail_mods}workshop/${octail_id};"; done; octail_mods="${octail_mods}${MODS}"; octail_mods="${octail_mods%;}"; mkdir -p keys; IFS=";" read -ra octail_dirs <<< "${octail_mods};${SERVER_MODS}"; for octail_d in "${octail_dirs[@]}"; do [ -n "${octail_d}" ] || continue; if [ ! -d "${octail_d}" ]; then echo "Mod folder ${octail_d} is missing; the server starts without it."; continue; fi; if [ "${MODS_LOWERCASE}" = 1 ]; then find "${octail_d}" -mindepth 1 -depth -name "*[A-Z]*" -exec sh -c 'for p; do n="${p%/*}/$(printf %s "${p##*/}" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")"; [ -e "$n" ] || mv "$p" "$n"; done' sh {} +; fi; find "${octail_d}" -iname "*.bikey" -exec cp -f -t keys {} +; done; if [ -d battleye ]; then for octail_be in battleye/beserver_x64.cfg battleye/launch/beserver_x64.cfg; do [ -d "${octail_be%/*}" ] || continue; touch "${octail_be}"; sed -i -e "/^RConPassword /d" -e "/^RConPort /d" -e "/^RConIP /d" "${octail_be}"; [ -z "${RCON_PASSWORD}" ] || printf "RConPassword %s
RConPort %s
RConIP 0.0.0.0
" "${RCON_PASSWORD}" "${RCON_PORT}" >> "${octail_be}"; done; fi; exec ./DayZServer -config=serverDZ.cfg -port="${SERVER_PORT}" -profiles=profiles -bepath=battleye "-mod=${octail_mods}" "-serverMod=${SERVER_MODS}" -dologs -adminlog -netlog -freezecheck

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD (the saved login of the server's Steam account) before every start.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (up to 64 characters, no " or \).

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Players need it to join; empty for an open server. Letters, digits and _.@%+!- only.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Typed in the game's chat as #login <password> to become admin. 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-.

variables.name: Mission
variables.description: The mission folder in mpmissions/ (mission.map): dayzOffline.chernarusplus (Chernarus), dayzOffline.enoch (Livonia), dayzOffline.sakhal (Sakhal), or an uploaded one.

variables.name: Time acceleration
variables.description: How much faster the in-game day runs than real time.

variables.name: Night acceleration
variables.description: Extra speed-up of the night, multiplied with the time acceleration.

variables.name: Persistent time
variables.description: 1 keeps the in-game time across restarts.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The Steam query port (UDP) for the server browser. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Workshop mods
variables.description: Steam Workshop item ids, comma-separated, in load order. The Steam Workshop tool fills this in and downloads them to workshop/<id> (needs a Steam account that owns the game); they load before the mods below.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Uploaded mod folders in the server folder, separated by ; in load order (for example @cba_a3;@ace). Players need the same mods.

variables.name: Server-side mods
variables.description: Mod folders only the server loads (-serverMod), separated by ;. Players don't need them.

variables.name: Lowercase mod files
variables.description: 1 renames every file and folder inside the listed mod folders to lowercase before each start. Linux is case-sensitive: turn it on when the server can't find files of a mod made on Windows.

variables.name: BattlEye RCon password
variables.description: Turns on BattlEye RCon for RCon tools (BEC, BattleWarden, …) when set: 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-. Empty leaves RCon off. Octail's console doesn't use it.

variables.name: BattlEye RCon port
variables.description: The BattlEye RCon port (UDP). Set by Octail when the server is created (three after the game port).
